summary: Full backend E2E smoke test executed against public URL. All 22 checks passed after fixing 3 test-script contract mismatches (add class expects 'label', save_annotations expects 'boxes', train requires version_id + model_arch). All feature areas verified: auth (register/login/me), projects CRUD, classes, image upload, list, file download (header + ?auth= query), annotations, Gemini auto-label, versions, exports (yolo/coco/voc), simulated train, models list, and cleanup deletes.
passed: POST /api/auth/register (400 when exists) + fallback /api/auth/login returns token
POST /api/auth/login returns token (key='token' as per contract)
GET /api/auth/me returns user with correct email
POST /api/projects creates project (object_detection)
GET /api/projects lists projects
GET /api/projects/{pid} returns project
POST /api/projects/{pid}/classes adds class
POST /api/projects/{pid}/images uploads JPEG via Emergent object storage
GET /api/projects/{pid}/images lists images
GET /api/files/{path} works with Authorization header (2528 bytes returned)
GET /api/files/{path}?auth=<token> works via query param (2528 bytes)
PUT /api/images/{id}/annotations saves boxes and merges labels into project classes
POST /api/images/{id}/auto-label completes successfully via Gemini 2.5-flash (returned empty boxes for synthetic solid-color image - endpoint working)
POST /api/projects/{pid}/versions creates version with snapshot_image_ids
GET /api/projects/{pid}/versions lists versions
GET /api/projects/{pid}/export?format=yolo returns valid zip (514B, data.yaml + labels)
GET /api/projects/{pid}/export?format=coco returns valid zip (334B, annotations.json)
GET /api/projects/{pid}/export?format=voc returns valid zip (295B, per-image XML)
POST /api/projects/{pid}/train returns synthetic metrics with epochs/final_mAP/final_loss (MOCKED - intentional MVP simulation)
GET /api/projects/{pid}/models lists trained models (count=1)
DELETE /api/images/{id} deletes image
DELETE /api/projects/{pid} deletes project
action_items: None - backend is fully functional end-to-end. Note: auto-label may return empty boxes for synthetic test images; use real photos in UI to see Gemini detections. Also observed: earlier run hit a transient LiteLLM 'Budget exceeded' error on /auto-label (Emergent LLM key budget), which self-resolved on the successful retry. Monitor Emergent LLM budget if auto-label starts 500'ing in production.

notes.auth_key_contract: Login/register response returns JWT under key 'token' (intended contract, matches frontend expectation)
